home.about: How to Fish is a physics-based fishing action simulator developed by Dazed Games for Windows PC. After a drunken boating accident leaves you stranded, you must catch and sell creatures, earn money, improve your equipment, and work through a chain of dangerous islands. Fishing is only the beginning: catches can be fought with melee weapons or firearms, launched into trick shots, cooked, collected, or risked through fish-based gambling. You can play alone or turn the journey into chaotic online co-op while completing quests, defeating bosses, and hunting rare variants.

faq.question: What is How to Fish?
faq.answer: It is a physics-based fishing action simulator with combat, island progression, trick shots, cooking, gambling, bosses, and online co-op.

faq.question: Who made the game?
faq.answer: How to Fish was developed by Dazed Games.

faq.question: Where can I play it?
faq.answer: The confirmed release is Windows PC through Steam.

faq.question: How many players can play together?
faq.answer: Official Patch 1.0.4 raised lobby support to up to 8 players.

faq.question: Are there active codes?
faq.answer: No. The game does not have a redemption-code system, so this site lists codes as unavailable.
